text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The "Spring Fan Thanksgiving Festival"— 
Daitaku Helios, a lover of all things fun, 
was enjoying it to the fullest, even more 
than the attendees.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: —Party people, assembleee!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Palmer-chin's aiming for the Tenno Sho 
(Spring)! 'Cause she's gonna tear it up 
there!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Cheer on your bestie, pretty please~☆

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Yaaay! Nice to meetcha!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Palmer, are you aiming for the Tenno Sho 
(Spring)? Will you be alright? McQueen and 
Ryan are running in it too, right?

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Even though we're both Mejiros, we've 
ended up so far apart...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"If anything, I ran away so far back that 
I ended up behind!! Like, coming full 
circle back to the front!"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Palmer-chin's gonna do her own thing☆ 
Without worrying about which Mejiro she 
is!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Right~☆

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah! I'll hype up the Spring Tenno 
Sho this year! Cheer me on, alright?

text_block_list.name: Fans A & B
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ayy ayyy☆ Don't forget my Yomiuri Milers 
Cup either!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Kyoto's bypassed spring straight into 
summer this year! Let's turn up the 
heat~!!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Ayyyyy~!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: *Gulp, gulp, gulp...*

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Puhaah! I got totally caught up in that 
today, too~!!
choice_data_list: You're really partying it up, huh.
You're really partying it up, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Right!?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
For events like this, you know! I just 
wanna see everyone smiling☆

text_block_list.name: Female Spectator
text_block_list.text:
—Ah, isn't that girl from the "Illustrious 
Clan"? You know, from that big news story 
back around New Year's.

text_block_list.name: Male Spectator
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you're right. ...Feels like it's been 
a while since I last saw one.

text_block_list.name: Female Spectator
text_block_list.text:
"You mainly focus on sprints right now, 
right? I don't really know too much about 
the girls in that division, to be honest."

text_block_list.name: Female Spectator
text_block_list.text:
I feel like I saw a lot of faces last 
year... But I guess their impressions 
really fade fast, don't they?

text_block_list.name: Male Spectator
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, shouldn't we go grab seats for Tokai 
Teio's event right now? She's definitely 
gonna win the Triple Crown and become a 
legend!"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: ...Umm, dis?
choice_data_list: I don't think that's the case, though.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The sprint division inevitably garners 
less attention than popular races like the 
Arima Kinen. Consequently, the attention 
on her is also...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Ruby!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Daitaku Helios suddenly broke into a run, 
and as she approached Daiichi Rubyâ

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Flee!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I grabbed her hand and took off running!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: —Please let me go!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...What is your intention here?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"I mean, the young lady looked totally 
bored, didn't she?!"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
If you don't like it, you just gotta run, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I am terribly sorry, but I do not quite 
understand what you mean. I have no memory 
of ever saying I disliked it.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Then was it fun? Did it make you happy? 
Did it make you feel like you wanted to 
stay here forever??

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"If you're not having fun, then just quit 
already!"

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...It seems you still do not understand.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I have told you time and time again, the 
world I see and the world you see are 
completely different.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"Things like 'fun'... are values 
unnecessary to me."

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Whaaat!?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: H-Huh!? Then what IS important!?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: My clan. —That is everything to me.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Ah, seriously, total nonsense!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
How can you NOT want to have fun?! I don't 
get it at all~!
choice_data_list: Or maybe Ruby thinks so too.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Huh?
choice_data_list: Everyone has their own way of thinking.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... but like, 'having fun' goes way 
deeper than that, right!?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that's it, I'm at my limit!! I can't 
take this anymooore!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Can I make some noise for now!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Being so honest and pure-hearted, Daitaku 
Helios quickly cleared her head... and 
thoroughly enjoyed the Spring Fan 
Thanksgiving Festival.
